newsitem.title: USA: General Motors to buy back $2.5 billion in stock.
newsitem.headline: General Motors to buy back $2.5 billion in stock.

text.p: General Motors Corp said Monday it will repurchase another $2.5 billion in common stock.

The automaker said it just completed a $2.5 billion repurchase program, begun in January, in which approximately 43.7 million shares of its $1-2/3 par value common stock were repurchased in six months.

"GM's cash position is strong," Chairman John Smith Jr. said in a statement. "We believe that stock repurchase programs are a great way to return excess cash directly to stockholders We expect to consider additional programs in the future, within the framework of the investment requirements to maintain and grow the business, the overall business climate, and our cash position going forward."
The stock repurchases will be made over a 12-month period principally through open market transactions, and would represent about five percent of the outstanding shares of GM $1-2/3 common stock.
